review_kind: Independent source, coverage, novelty, and actual-question/key-scope review
verdict: REVISE BEFORE FULL-BANK BLIND TEST OR FREEZE
scope: FFG English original 2008 CE01, original 50 aliens, normal encounters/alien/flare system and applicable base FAQ. No Technology, variants, Anniversary extras, or expansions.

findings.finding: The reference map losslessly indexes the candidate key, but it is not an asked-fact map. Several records contain unasked background or combine an asked rule with unasked examples, numeric detail, or exceptions.
findings.fix: Apply the accompanying per-question overlay before scoring. Preserve all original Q001–Q020 questions and key records verbatim; version the scope overlay. Keep actually requested actors, timing, costs, exceptions, and outcomes required. Do not score the excluded background or credit it as tested coverage.
examples: Q004 asks own-color choices, not the reclamation ship cap/source or phase cutoff.
Q007 asks defensive placement, not the allied launch cap/source; Q152 explicitly asks those.
Q012 asks planet eligibility, not ship sources; Q154 explicitly asks the latter.
Q015 ordinary limits do not itself ask the canceled-flare exception.
Q018's all-printed-parts question asks use/non-use, not a recital of cancellation duration or named examples.

findings.finding: The original empty-home reclamation ship cap and source restrictions are key background in Q004 and are not asked by Q078 or any other question.
sources: Original rulebook p7, If a Color is Drawn; p12, Driving Out Foreign Colonies note
findings.fix: Add the explicit ship-number/source clause proposed as P01, preferably by extending unfrozen Q078. Do not alter the retained original twenty.

findings.finding: Q123 tests Reserve Wild's one-play duration, but does not ask the qualifying discarded-card type, other-player restriction, or card-to-own-hand acquisition. No other question asks that rule.
findings.fix: Extend Q123 or add P02; count only the additional action/eligibility facts as new. Do not count the entire FAQ entry as covered solely because its replay rule is tested.

findings.finding: The general simultaneous-landing rule is stated in an expansion-alien section with an explicit original-base Mobius Tubes example. It remains a positive base-relevant rule after excluding Saboteur's trap/token mechanics. Neither Q075 (no-colony destinations), Q010 (rewards/destinations), nor Q134 (simultaneous losses) asks simultaneous arrivals.
sources: 2018 FAQ p19, Saboteur answer, extracted/cosmic-encounter-faq.txt lines1793–1798; general statement at1796–1797
findings.fix: Add P03 asking simultaneous landing of ships released by Mobius Tubes. Do not import Saboteur, traps, tokens, or the trap-revelation commitment subclause.

findings.finding: The scenario says the Super was already played. 'Wild available while the power is zapped' is overbroad if treated as permission to play the same flare again in that encounter. Canceling the enabled power does not cancel the played flare or remove the ordinary per-player/per-flare limits.
sources: 2018 FAQ p6 lines578–581 (FAQ-Q073) and p6 lines525–537
findings.fix: Version a clarification distinguishing Wild access from eligibility to play again. Keep the flare; no compulsory discard or immediate Wild. In the stated already-played-Super scenario, ordinary once-per-encounter limits still bar a second play absent an explicit exception. Do not penalize an answer that makes this distinction.

findings.finding: The asked distinction between losing/lost/sent ships needs the source's qualification that the 'sent' category is not directly involved in the encounter. F02 currently omits it and can be read as classifying every effect-caused encounter loss identically.
findings.fix: Version an explicit asked atom for the omitted distinction while preserving the source's actual-arrival and sent-counts-as-lost rules. Avoid importing the excluded Fungus/Remote examples.

findings.finding: 'Which portion requires power use' is explicitly asked. F03/F04 imply the distinction by using 'use' only for activation, but a scoring key should state the requested answer directly.
sources: Original Citadel sheet, native image and body; original rulebook p4 alien-sheet use definition and p12 Zapping Powers
findings.fix: State that placement is a non-use clause and activating all citadels is the power use. This clarifies an existing asked rule and is not a new question or a license to change the original twenty.

findings.finding: The FAQ conditional is authoritative, but this question does not establish a reachable current-core application. Occupying all five planets of a foreign system ordinarily already satisfies victory at the end of Resolution before a later Destiny phase. A home-system drive-out reading is a different case and is not delimited here.
findings.adjudication: Do not count Q086 as a proved reachable current-core novelty in its present form. Preserve the literal FAQ conditional as authority/context. Require a positively sourced base-only enabling state and an explicitly delimited question before accepting it as a live scenario; otherwise exclude that scenario from the final bank. Do not invent a win-extension, destroyed-planet, or expansion mechanism.

findings.finding: Q143 expressly asks what the original rulebook says about a self-designating special. That conditional is printed in the original rulebook; similarly the copied-Reincarnator branch is printed on the original Reincarnator sheet. Documentary support is established, but a positive original-base enabling card/power has not been established for either conditional.
sources: Original Reincarnator sheet final rules sentence
findings.adjudication: Retain as expressly delimited source-text conditionals if the bank includes documentary rules coverage. Do not claim they demonstrate reachable current-core encounter branches or assume expansion enabling effects. The map labels their asked facts conditional and withholds reachable-branch novelty credit.

findings.finding: Two previous parent zero-addition passes do not establish saturation after this independent challenge. At least three source-supported actual-coverage additions remain, together with scoring-scope and conditional-applicability corrections.
findings.fix: Reset the zero-addition counter when P01–P03 are accepted or otherwise source-adjudicated. Re-run targeted source-to-asked-fact passes on the versioned bank, then obtain an independent challenge. Pending publisher-ambiguity decisions remain pending; this review does not choose an interpretation.

proposals.question: When your own-color destiny permits automatic recolonization of a completely ship-empty home planet, how many ships may you place there, and from which of your holdings may they come?
asked_facts: The ships come from the player's other existing colonies; the rule does not give a general direct warp-to-empty-home permission.
exact_sources: Original rulebook p7 If a Color is Drawn, extracted/cosmic-encounter-rules.txt lines549–553
Original rulebook p12 Driving Out Foreign Colonies note, lines974–979
proposals.novelty: The rule-defined maximum and eligible ship sources are not asked elsewhere. Q078's win/status/phase questions remain separate. This is not a new set of arbitrary ship quantities.
proposals.positive_base_relevance: An explicit ordinary own-color empty-home branch in the 2008 base rulebook.

proposals.question: While a legally played Reserve Wild remains active this encounter, whose discarded cards of what type may its user take, and where do those cards go?
asked_facts: Whenever another player discards a reinforcement card, the user may take it.
The card is added to the user's own hand.
The rule refers to another player's discard, not a new right to recover the user's own discarded reinforcement.
exact_sources: 2018 FAQ p19 Reserve Wild, extracted/cosmic-encounter-faq.txt lines1784–1789 (FAQ-Q337)
proposals.novelty: Adds actual card eligibility and acquisition, which the existing duration-only clause does not ask. Do not count its already-tested one-play/encounter duration as new.
proposals.positive_base_relevance: Reserve is one of the original fifty; this FAQ names its Wild flare and gives the action directly, with no excluded component required.

proposals.question: When Mobius Tubes releases a player's ships and those ships are placed on that player's existing colonies, do the ships land simultaneously or one ship at a time?
asked_facts: The ships land on colonies simultaneously.
exact_sources: 2018 FAQ p19 Saboteur answer, extracted/cosmic-encounter-faq.txt lines1796–1797
proposals.novelty: A new arrival-timing rule. Existing atomic power movement and simultaneous ship losses do not test simultaneous landing. No trap, Saboteur token, or excluded reaction is assumed.
proposals.positive_base_relevance: The official general statement explicitly uses the base Mobius Tubes release as its example.

source_assessment.alien_sheet_result: All fifty original_file images were transported and emitted at detail original. Every actual decoded JPEG payload hash, byte count, and dimensions matched its pinned original. Printed rules body, setup clauses, roles, optional/mandatory flag, and highlighted phase strip were read; no OCR/community prose used as authority.
source_assessment.text_result: All six permitted bank inputs, both complete source text extractions, the entire historical cached extraction, and the provenance manifest were read in contiguous chunks no larger than 6000 characters. One outer-output truncation in the reference map was repaired by re-reading both affected ranges.
source_assessment.historical_authority: The retained May 6 2009 cached extraction supplies the retained Macron/Spiff/Warrior/Mind Wild/Reincarnator Wild errata. Its cache hash is recorded separately; no original historical PDF hash is asserted. Later 2018 rulings supersede conflicting old answers.
source_assessment.pending_ambiguities: No human choice was inferred for the recorded reinforcement/negotiate conflict or ordinary reveal/Calculator equality/Hate equality topics.
